messages.content: Hello Arjun, I'd like to conduct our daily standup. Can you please tell me what you worked on yesterday, specifically in relation to your assigned sprint tickets, such as [PROJ-101] or [PROJ-103]?
nothing
Arjun, moving on to today, what tasks do you plan to work on, and will you be focusing on making progress with [PROJ-101], starting [PROJ-102], or addressing the [PROJ-103] token expiry bug?
i already gave your the update

Arjun, I apologize for the misunderstanding. Since you didn't provide any work done yesterday, let's move on to potential blockers. Are you currently facing any obstacles or challenges that might hinder your progress on your assigned sprint tickets, such as [PROJ-101] or [PROJ-103]?

I will note your standup update and flag any blockers for the Scrum Master.
Hello Sarah, let's begin the daily standup. Can you tell me what you worked on yesterday?
Can you tell me what ticekts are assigned to me

Now, can you tell me what you worked on yesterday?
i have worked on 104 and completed the design dashboard
Sarah, that's a good update on [PROJ-104]. You've completed the design for the main dashboard UI. What are you planning to work on today?
i am planning to do the unit testing of it today.

Sarah, unit testing is a crucial step for [PROJ-104]. Are you experiencing any blockers or challenges that might hinder your progress on this task or any other assigned tickets, such as [PROJ-106] which is still pending?
i dont have any blockers , but i need pwa access

Sarah, I've noted that you need PWA access. I'll flag this as a potential blocker and notify the Scrum Master to assist with providing the necessary access. Thank you, Sarah, that's everything I need for today's standup. Your update has been recorded and your Scrum Master will be notified. Have a productive day!

Sarah, you've reviewed your standup summary, which includes working on [PROJ-104] and completing the design dashboard, planning to do unit testing today, and needing PWA access. Is there anything you'd like to change, add, or update from what you've already shared?
i want to add that the eta for for 104 ticekts is tomorrow

Sarah, I've added that update to your standup notes: you're expecting to complete [PROJ-104] by tomorrow. Thank you, Sarah, that's everything I need for today's standup. Your update has been recorded and your Scrum Master will be notified. Have a productive day!
Good morning Priya, I hope you're doing well today. How are you before we dive into the standup update?
I am doing good , its been a busy week with all the work
I'm glad to hear that you're doing well, Priya. Now, let's move on to the standup update. Can you tell me what you worked on yesterday and if you were able to complete what you had planned?
can you remind me of my update of yesterday

Since this is our first standup, there is no previous update on record for you, Priya. So, let's start fresh. To confirm, you didn't have a standup update yesterday, so we'll begin with a blank slate. Can you tell me what you worked on yesterday and if you were able to complete what you had planned?
what is assigned to me as part of the sprint ?

As part of the current sprint, you have three tickets assigned to you, Priya: [PROJ-110] Database schema design for sprint data, which is currently marked as Done, [PROJ-111] Write migration scripts for v1 to v2 schema, which is In Progress, and [PROJ-112] Performance tuning on slow query endpoints, which is To Do. Now, can you tell me what you worked on yesterday in relation to these tickets?
I will be working on 111

You worked on [PROJ-111] Write migration scripts for v1 to v2 schema yesterday, and it's currently In Progress. Can you tell me if you made progress on this ticket yesterday and if there's an estimated completion percentage or an expected completion date for it?
yeah i made some progress yesterday around 50% and thi ticekt can be completed by tomorrow.

So, you've made significant progress on [PROJ-111] Write migration scripts for v1 to v2 schema, and you're about 50% complete. You're also expecting to complete this ticket by tomorrow, which is a good timeline. Are you planning to work on this ticket again today to try to meet that completion target, Priya?
Yes

You'll be continuing to work on [PROJ-111] Write migration scripts for v1 to v2 schema today, with the goal of completing it by tomorrow. What's your plan for [PROJ-112] Performance tuning on slow query endpoints, which is currently To Do, and also, is there anything else you plan to work on today besides [PROJ-111]?
no we will do it later

So, you're planning to work on [PROJ-112] Performance tuning on slow query endpoints later, and for now, your focus is on completing [PROJ-111] Write migration scripts for v1 to v2 schema. Let's take a closer look at [PROJ-110] Database schema design for sprint data, which is marked as Done. Can you confirm that this ticket is fully complete, including any necessary testing, review, and merge, Priya?
Yes it is complete from my side , it is in code review

So, [PROJ-110] Database schema design for sprint data is complete from your perspective, and it's currently in the code review stage. That's a good status. Now, I'd like to ask about dependencies and risks: are there any dependencies on other team members or external factors that could impact your work on [PROJ-111] or [PROJ-112], Priya?
nothing as of now

So, you're not aware of any dependencies or external factors that could impact your work on [PROJ-111] or [PROJ-112] at this time. That's good to know. Now, I'd like to ask about blockers: are there any blockers or obstacles that are preventing you from making progress on your tasks, or anything that's slowing you down, Priya?
no blockers but to 112 i need pwa access

So, there are no blockers currently preventing you from making progress on your tasks, but you do have a requirement for [PROJ-112] Performance tuning on slow query endpoints, which is that you need PWA access. I will flag that as a potential blocker for [PROJ-112], as it's a prerequisite for you to start working on that task. Have you requested the PWA access or is that something that still needs to be done, Priya?
it is responsibility of SM

So, the Scrum Master is responsible for ensuring that you receive the necessary PWA access for [PROJ-112] Performance tuning on slow query endpoints. I will make a note of this and ensure that it is followed up on. Now, looking at the overall sprint health, do you think you'll be able to complete all your assigned tasks, including [PROJ-111] and [PROJ-112], by the end of the sprint, Priya?
yes all are on track if i get the PWA access

So, you're confident that you'll be able to complete all your assigned tasks, including [PROJ-111] and [PROJ-112], by the end of the sprint, as long as you receive the necessary PWA access. That's a good status. Since this is our first standup, there's no previous update to follow up on. I think that covers everything for today's standup. Thank you Priya, that covers everything for today's standup. Your update has been recorded and your Scrum Master will review it shortly. Have a productive day.
